title.en: One distant galaxy, seen twice: Hubble lends Roman a map
title.zh: 同一个远方星系，现身两次：哈勃为Roman探路

summary.en: NASA’s October22 Hubble image shows an arc-counterarc gravitational lens; sharp observations help prepare future Roman dark-matter studies, not a new dark-matter particle detection.
summary.zh: NASA于10月22日介绍哈勃弧与反弧引力透镜图像；精细观测为Roman未来暗物质研究铺路，非发现暗物质粒子。

title.en: Who watches the AI watchdog? A study tests what it cannot see
title.zh: 谁来看住AI看门人？一项实验检验它看不见的地方

summary.en: Anthropic Fellows red-team study tests September2026 blocking-monitor snapshots under deliberately adversarial conditions; better coverage helps, while context-spanning defenses carry a latency cost.
summary.zh: Anthropic Fellows以刻意对抗条件测试2026年9月监测器快照；扩大覆盖有所改善，跨上下文防御仍有时延代价。
